about: Revoked widget publisher keys (the owner's and Themely's). Ships with app updates only; never fetched. A key here refuses every package it signed. Entry: { "key": "<minisign public key line>", "reason": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" }.
packsAbout: Withdrawn theme packs: by id (and version) for a signed pack, or by manifest SHA-256 for any. Entry: { "id": "...", "version": "x.y.z", "manifestSha256": "...", "reason": "..." }. A key in revoked refuses the packs it signed too.
